String.string:
[EN] You enter the world of Lakan's soul.
[ES] Entras al mundo del alma de Lakan.

[EN] Darkan's Wrath
[ES] Ira de Darkan

[EN] Soul Saturation
[ES] Saturación de alma

[EN] Fools, all of you!
[ES] ¡Insensatos, todos ustedes!

[EN] You'll die here!
[ES] ¡Morirán aquí!

[EN] I AM INVINCIBLE!
[ES] ¡SOY INVENCIBLE!

[EN] I will not fail my master! Not again!
[ES] ¡No le fallaré a mi amo! ¡Otra vez no!

[EN] Mana generators have evolved.
[ES] Los generadores de maná han evolucionado.

[EN] Giving up so soon?
[ES] ¿Te rindes tan pronto?

[EN] A minion will be summoned when attacked by a shard!
[ES] ¡Un esbirro será invocado al ser atacado por un fragmento!

[EN] I will rip you apart!
[ES] ¡Te haré pedazos!

[EN] I call upon the power of dark mana!
[ES] ¡Invoco el poder del maná oscuro!

[EN] Dark mana explosion!
[ES] ¡Explosión de maná oscuro!

[EN] Balance
[ES] Equilibrio

[EN] You cannot defend against me.
[ES] No puedes defenderte de mí.

[EN] Velik is weakening!
[ES] ¡Velik se está debilitando!

[EN] Lakan's power is infecting the Sanctuary!
[ES] ¡El poder de Lakan está infectando el Santuario!

[EN] Velik has fainted.
[ES] Velik se ha desmayado.

[EN] Lakan's energy is corrupting the Sanctuary!
[ES] ¡La energía de Lakan está corrompiendo el Santuario!

[EN] Drown in your blessings.
[ES] Ahógate en tus bendiciones.

[EN] Cursed by Lakan in 1 minute! Healing spells deal damage instead!
[ES] ¡Maldito por Lakan en 1 minuto! ¡Los hechizos de curación infligen daño en su lugar!

[EN] Begone!
[ES] ¡Fuera de aquí!

[EN] Be cursed by god!
[ES] ¡Sé maldito por el dios!

[EN] Pitiful mortals... You never had a chance.
[ES] Mecánicos patéticos... Nunca tuviste una oportunidad.

[EN] You have been inside Lakan's soul for too long, and became corrupted by his evil.
[ES] Has estado dentro del alma de Lakan demasiado tiempo y te has corrompido con su maldad.

[EN] You have failed.
[ES] Has fracasado.

[EN] Lakan has noticed you.
[ES] Lakan te ha notado.

[EN] Lakan is trying to take you on one at a time.
[ES] Lakan está intentando acabar contigo de uno en uno.

[EN] Lakan intends to kill all of you at once.
[ES] Lakan pretende matarlos a todos a la vez.

[EN] Thank you... for this release...
[ES] Gracias... por esta liberación...

[EN] Beware the... red lightning...
[ES] Cuidado con el... rayo rojo...

[EN] Beware the mark... of Lakan...
[ES] Cuidado con la marca... de Lakan...

[EN] The combat area will close soon.
[ES] El área de combate se cerrará pronto.

[EN] Though dead, his power still lingers. Exit this place quickly.
[ES] Aunque está muerto, su poder aún persiste. Sal de este lugar rápidamente.

[EN] Ah, Velik!
[ES] ¡Ah, Velik!

[EN] I will return Oriyn's Arcana to Highwatch. We'll speak more at headquarters.
[ES] Devolveré la Arcana de Oriyn a Highwatch. Hablaremos más en la base.
